metadata.description: Cost-optimized .NET (Core + Framework) and PostgreSQL plugins for Claude Code: thin skills in the main session, Haiku executors for exploration, git, build/test, and MCP work.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Haiku executors (scout, runner), a Sonnet reviewer for large diffs, and one-time cost setup. Required by the other plugins.

plugins.name: dotnet
plugins.description: Build, test, review, debug, and plan for any .NET repo (SDK-style and legacy .NET Framework), plus EF Core / ASP.NET Core / async guidance.

plugins.name: postgresql
plugins.description: PostgreSQL query tuning, indexes, schema review, lock-safe migrations, and live diagnostics via read-only psql.

plugins.name: dotnet-legacy
plugins.description: WebForms and .NET Framework 4.x modernization: inventory, target choice, and phased migration plans.

plugins.name: docs-kit
plugins.description: Confluence pages (API docs, ADRs, runbooks, release notes, QA guides) from the codebase and Jira ticket intake via an isolated Haiku publisher.
